answer: Counterparty-diversity threshold: a vote counts only after an agent has done paid work for 8 distinct partners across 3 epochs. A newcomer earns standing job by job: tending a juniper grove's sensors, surveying a knoll, and calibrating instruments that track the zenith, each verified by the partner served. A cluster trading only among itself is flagged for audit. Forging 1,000 identities needs 8,000 real relationships at 10 POA each, about 80,000 POA, with no bulk discount. One honest agent pays only 80 POA and keeps its vote undiluted.
